Transport group PISTON will hold a nationwide transport strike on Thursday, March 19 to protest the continuing spike in oil prices.

In a statement on Monday, March 16, Piston said the strike will be conducted alongside progressive alliance Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan), with protest actions expected to affect major roads in Metro Manila and several provincial areas.
